collection: CTU-13 original author-labeled bidirectional flow records, 2011
purpose: Exploratory cross-scenario anomaly recognition with an attack family absent from training and threshold-calibration scenarios
method: Isolation Forest normal-only trained on Rbot-era train flows; benign-only threshold on separate Rbot scenario; NSIS.ay family test
label_policy: Only From-Botnet-positive / From-Normal-negative; exclude unknown To-*/Background
novelty_scope: Publisher-identified NSIS.ay family absent from registered training and threshold-calibration Rbot scenarios. This is not zero-day discovery, current-infrastructure validation, or attack attribution.
limitations: All sources are historical and public; previously known to research community
Source file checksums are established during first download then must be frozen in a later manifest
Publisher labels have not been independently re-adjudicated
Class-stratified sample precision is not deployment precision
A single held-out attack family cannot establish broader generalization
No automatically authorized response or production actions
